Describe the expected and actual behavior, exact Relay revision, platform/tool
versions, minimal synthetic reproduction and commands/results. State whether
this concerns local qualification or an installed consumer.

Do not include credentials, private source or raw diagnostics. For sensitive
findings, follow SECURITY.md. A bug report does not admit automatic Codex work.
